fields.label: GitLab host
fields.help: GitLab host passed to glab --hostname

fields.label: glab executable
fields.help: glab executable

fields.label: glab timeout (seconds)
fields.help: Timeout for one glab call

fields.label: Active poll interval (seconds)
fields.help: Poll interval while you are at the Mac

fields.label: Idle poll interval (seconds)
fields.help: Poll interval while idle

fields.label: Idle after (seconds)
fields.help: No keyboard or mouse input for this long counts as idle

fields.label: Maximum backoff (seconds)
fields.help: Cap for the exponential backoff after failed polls

fields.label: Summary threshold
fields.help: More notifications than this in one poll become one summary

fields.label: Ignored authors
fields.help: GitLab usernames whose comments never alert (for example bots)

fields.label: Teams enabled
fields.help: Switch the Teams flows on

fields.label: Teams MCP command
fields.help: Command that starts the Teams MCP server

fields.label: Teams start timeout (seconds)
fields.help: Timeout for the Teams MCP to start

fields.label: Teams call timeout (seconds)
fields.help: Timeout for one Teams MCP call

fields.label: Nudge mode
fields.help: How the nudge flow sends: auto, approval or dry-run

fields.label: Notice mode
fields.help: How the Review Notice flow sends: auto, approval or dry-run

fields.label: Re-review mode
fields.help: How the Re-review Nudge flow sends: auto, approval or dry-run

fields.label: Findings notice mode
fields.help: How the Review Notice with an Agent Review's findings sends: auto, approval or dry-run

fields.label: Approval notice mode
fields.help: How the Review Notice after you approve an MR sends: auto, approval or dry-run. It goes out at the first poll that sees the approval

fields.label: Working hours start
fields.help: Messages only go out inside these hours (Mac local time)

fields.label: Working hours end
fields.help: Messages only go out inside these hours (Mac local time)

fields.label: Working days
fields.help: ISO weekdays, Monday is 1 and Sunday is 7

fields.label: Reminder after (hours)
fields.help: Reminder if the Reviewer is still UNREVIEWED this long after the nudge

fields.label: Notice debounce (minutes)
fields.help: Review Notice after this long without further change by you

fields.label: Re-review after (minutes)
fields.help: Re-review Nudge after your latest push has stood this long without a newer one

fields.label: Messages per Reviewer
fields.help: At most this many messages per MR per Reviewer

fields.label: Templates folder
fields.help: Folder with template files

fields.label: People
fields.help: GitLab username to email, for people Teams cannot find by name

fields.label: Agent name
fields.help: The name the agent introduces itself with in Teams messages ({{agent.name}})

fields.label: Model CLI
fields.help: Which coding agent CLI runs language model work: auto (the first installed of claude, codex, gemini), claude, codex or gemini

fields.label: Review automatically
fields.help: Review every MR waiting for you that the agent has not reviewed yet, oldest first, and again after a new Review Request; reviews wait in the app until you post them

fields.label: Posting
fields.help: approval: a ready review waits until you post it; auto: it is posted to GitLab as you as soon as it is ready

fields.label: Post as
fields.help: comment: the review is one comment on the MR; inline: each finding that names a line of the reviewed diff becomes a thread on that line, and the rest is one comment. The app asks each time; automatic posting and suica review post use this

fields.label: Approve after a clean re-review
fields.help: Approve the MR as you at the reviewed commit once an Agent Re-review with no new findings and every previous finding fixed is posted

fields.label: Review skill
fields.help: Claude Code skill the review follows, as typed after the slash (plugin:skill)

fields.label: Review model
fields.help: Model the CLI reviews with, such as sonnet, opus or haiku for Claude Code, or a full model name; empty uses the CLI's default

fields.label: Largest MR (changed lines)
fields.help: Larger MRs are skipped

fields.label: Automatic reviews per day
fields.help: At most this many automatic reviews in 24 hours; reviews you start yourself do not count

fields.label: Re-review after (minutes)
fields.help: Re-review an MR after the Author's latest push has stood this long without a newer one

fields.label: Review timeout (minutes)
fields.help: A review run is stopped after this long

fields.label: State file
fields.help: SQLite state file
fields.restartNote: A new path starts with an empty history and a fresh baseline.
